title: Richard Stoltzman Woody Herman Thundering Herd Ebony CD RCA Victor Jazz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Richard Stoltzman with Woody Herman's Thundering Herd - Ebony
(RCA Victor Red Seal 6486-2-RC, 1988). Recorded May 11 and 12, 1987 at
RCA's Studio A, New York City. DDD.

Richard Stoltzman, clarinet; Woody Herman's Thundering Herd.
Produced by Leroy Parkins.

1. American Medley (Amazing Grace / America, the Beautiful / Battle Hymn of the Republic) (8:59)
2. Come Sunday (Ellington) (5:12)
3. Apple Honey (Herman) (4:52)
4-6. Ebony Concerto (Stravinsky) (9:39): Allegro moderato / Andante / Moderato, Con moto
7. Igor (Rogers-Norvo) (2:57)
8. Stories from the West Side (Bernstein): Somewhere / Cool / Maria / Something's Coming (12:08)
9. Waltz for Woody (Douglas) (4:37)
10. Cousins (J. Coppola-Guaraldi) (4:12)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
